summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting daily transactions under its share repurchase programme, which is the US-equivalent disclosure for a Danish issuer's buyback executed under EU MAR Safe Harbour Rules. Repurchases run 6 May 2026 to 1 Feb 2027 for up to DKK 11.2bn, part of a broader DKK 15bn 12-month programme begun 4 Feb 2026. In the week to 11 Sep 2026, 1,050,000 B shares were bought at average prices of DKK 278.62-297.98; cumulative programme purchases reach 18,325,000 shares for DKK 5.53bn, with treasury holdings at 1.1% of capital. Watch execution pace, daily volume caps and any programme expansion or suspension signaling capital-allocation shifts.
